title: Interview notes sheet
subject: English
source: Written for english/y6 lesson 40 (Interview notes sheet)
intro: Lesson 40: Newspaper reports: headline, byline, quotation, and interviewing a witness. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Feature
Example
rows: "Every screen froze," said the IT manager.
She said the files had been backed up.

model.title: Direct: "I have never seen anything like it," said the manager.

parts.text: Add that: The manager said that...

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The manager said that she had never seen anything like it.

keywords.def: the title of a news story, in large print
the exact words someone said, in inverted commas
what someone said, retold without their exact words

questions.q: Write an open question for the IT manager
questions.a: For example: How did you find out the network was infected?

questions.q: Change to reported speech: "We backed up all the files," said the technician.
questions.a: The technician said that they had backed up all the files.

questions.q: Write a dramatic but honest headline
questions.a: For example: Virus Freezes Classroom Screens

questions.q: Core: interview the teacher in role (a pretend member of staff) with five open questions, then write the answers as notes and two quotations (portal response box)
questions.a: Five questions, notes and two quotations

questions.q: Extend: turn one quotation into reported speech
Stretch: write the opening paragraph with the five Ws
questions.a: For example: On Monday morning, a computer virus froze every screen at a school, after a pupil opened a fake email.

questions.q: Which is an open interview question?
options: What happened when the screens froze?
questions.a: B) What happened when the screens froze?. B needs a full answer. A and C can be answered yes or no.

questions.q: Write one quotation from the interview
